reviewProfile.purpose: Put the cycle's person events in the paper as news, one person at a time — a birth, a death, a hospital stay, a retirement, a promotion, a household set up or a place of one's own, a win or a loss on the book, what a turn of the city did to someone's day, and the smaller moments the record kept. The event is the lead, the person is named as the slice names them, and what came next appears only when a later record holds it. A stake or a payout is the person's own fact, not a statistic. The page is the city's real calendar; every person on it is one the record holds.

approvedQuotes.text: I've been playing to climb — a place of my own first. The last stretch threw a money week that mattered. Now I'm renting a place on Piedmont Ave.
The window paid, that's all I can say. The week changed color. I was on cloud nine for a bit.

I wasn't too surprised when the slip came back empty. I'd been thinking about it, and it just didn't feel right. Losing 247 isn't great, but it's not the end of the world either. I've been around here long enough to know that sometimes things just don't go your way.
I attended a community feedback session for the Fruitvale Transit Hub Phase II and actually felt heard. That's the kind of initiative work that resonates with me.
